UPDATE leads SET
  meeting_scheduled_date = '{{update_lidor_lead.params.meeting_date}}',
  meeting_time = '{{update_lidor_lead.params.meeting_time}}',
  assigned_agent = '{{update_lidor_lead.params.agent}}',
  lead_passed = '{{update_lidor_lead.params.lead_passed}}',
  deal_closed = '{{update_lidor_lead.params.deal_closed}}',
  notes = '{{update_lidor_lead.params.notes}}',
  touched_by_lidor = TRUE,
  user_updated_at = CURRENT_DATE,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{update_lidor_lead.params.lead_id}}'
